literal: In feigned anger, those who yielded are the ones who won; that truth indeed in reunion will be seen.
translation: In a lovers' tiff, those who yield are the ones who truly win; this truth will indeed be realized in the sweet reunion that follows.
modern: ஊடலில் தோற்றுப்போனவர்களே உண்மையில் வென்றவர்கள் ஆவர்; அந்த உண்மை பின்னர் நிகழும் கூடலின் போது தெளிவாக உணரப்படும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights a beautiful paradox in the intimacy of lovers. In a lovers' tiff or feigned anger (ūṭal), the partner who yields or 'loses' the argument is actually the true winner. By giving up their stubbornness, they initiate the end of the conflict. The truth of this victory is fully realized and felt during the immense joy of their subsequent physical and emotional reunion (kūṭal).
